rationale.hitl-workflow: Proposes PRV cycle as a human-centered workflow and control surface.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Proposes naming conventions to maintain an auditable record of AI changes.
rationale.intro-framing: Conceptual paper defining the PRV workflow without empirical evaluation or implementation.
rationale.counterpoint: Argues against fully autonomous frameworks, insisting on active human oversight.
rationale.steering: The framework's Prompt stage and naming conventions actively shape code generation.
rationale.risk-quality: The Refactor step explicitly mitigates technical debt and poor code maintainability.
rationale.risk-overreliance: The Verify step mitigates uncritical trust and overreliance on AI outputs.
rationale.assistive: Focuses on human-initiated conversational AI coding through iterative prompt refinement.
rationale.agentic: Prompts generate complete artifacts like controllers that require holistic manual review.
